info.album: Captain Fantastic And The Brown Dirt Cowboy

podcast.body: Co-written by Elton John and Bernie Taupin, this song, from the 1975 album "Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy," was inspired by Billie Jean King and her World Team Tennis team, the Philadelphia Freedoms. However, it functions more as a tribute to the city of Philadelphia, embodying the "Philadelphia sound" with its R&B feel and lush strings. Elton John described it as "black music" and aimed for it to sound like a "funky black record" that would cross over into the "black market" (meaning music charts). The lyrics celebrate Philadelphia as the "cradle of freedom" rather than explicitly mentioning tennis. "So Bernie wrote this. If a call is right, I'd leave to find an answer on the road."
